goal: Drive a fixture through the real orchestrate loop with a scripted invoker and summarizer seam so the new mid-turn interrupt-to-recovery path is produced AND applied end-to-end by the real loop: occupancy crosses the ratio mid-iteration, the iteration is interrupted, Outcome.RECOVERED is recorded, the recovery attempt starts with `# Recovery handoff`, and a harness.context_recovery event with trigger="mid_turn" is persisted.

references: .workflow/specs/00019-FEATURE-intra-iteration-context-safety-net.md FR-8 (real loop drives the full mid-turn summarize-restart) and FR-4/FR-6 (both loop-produced ends + persisted trigger="mid_turn" event)

tests/test_context_recovery_in_loop.py -- the spec 00018 boundary in-loop slot; model the mid-turn slot on it, but cross the ratio MID-iteration via streamed AssistantMessage.usage rather than at the boundary
tests/test_worker.py::test_run_once_merges_completed_task -- model for driving a full real-loop cycle with a scripted invoke against a real store
constraints: FR-4/FR-6: drive BOTH loop-produced ends -- the harness PRODUCING the mid-turn recovery (the iteration is interrupted, RECOVERED finalize, harness.context_recovery with trigger="mid_turn") AND APPLYING it (the next attempt actually starts and its prompt carries `# Recovery handoff`). Stubbing either end fails the slot.

Cross the ratio MID-iteration: feed the injectable client/invoker seam a scripted client whose get_context_usage()/streamed AssistantMessage.usage rises past context_recovery_trigger_ratio before the iteration would naturally complete (set context_window_tokens on the real HarnessConfig), plus a scripted recovery_summarizer_invoke -- never call a paid/network agent.

Assert against the real persisted store: the harness.context_recovery event present with trigger="mid_turn" and ordered before the recovery attempt's AttemptStarted, Outcome.RECOVERED on the interrupted attempt, and the summarizer's content in the second attempt's prompt.
Do not stub orchestrate, harness, or SqliteStore -- only the agent's streamed text/usage and the summarizer's returned text are scripted.
Never read, write, or migrate .workflow/flywheel.sqlite -- fixture/temp stores only.
Tag MUST include `in-loop-verification` verbatim -- archive_completed_phases keys off this exact tag to recognize the verify task.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (test: ... or feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: FR-4's v(N-1) store-seeding + forward-migration clause does NOT apply: this feature adds no schema column/table (spec Decisions Log) -- do not seed or migrate a prior-version store.
Do not auto-generate the fixture or assertions; the human authoring the slot writes the test body.
Do not test the boundary recovery path (covered by tests/test_context_recovery_in_loop.py), compact/fork, or a recover control verb -- all out of scope.
